description: This file defines a servlet filter class 'SeoContextFilter' that manages access control and URL rewriting for SEO purposes within a Java web application. It initializes configuration from servlet context parameters, processes incoming requests to restrict access based on allowed paths, handles URL forwarding based on regex patterns, and integrates with the Apache OFBiz framework for web app management.

classes.name: SeoContextFilter
classes.description: A servlet filter for access restriction and URL rewriting based on SEO configuration within an OFBiz web application.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes filter configuration, loads allowed paths, redirect path, error codes, and registers servlets.

methods.name: doFilter
methods.description: Processes each incoming request to enforce access restrictions, handle URL forwarding, and manage request dispatching or error responses.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Performs cleanup if necessary; currently empty.

methods.name: forwardUri
methods.description: Performs URL rewriting based on configured regex patterns and triggers URL forwarding in HttpServletResponse.
